name: Mechanical pencil
summary: Each press of the end button pushes a thin lead a little further out of the tip, and the lead stays put while you write.

parts.name: Barrel
parts.role: The plastic tube you hold, with the lead and the works inside.

parts.name: Metal tip
parts.role: The narrow cone the lead comes out of.

parts.name: End button
parts.role: The cap you press, with an eraser under it.

parts.name: Pocket clip
parts.role: A springy metal strip on the side.
